privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: How AlgoVerse uses account, learning and payment information, and how to export or delete your data.
sections: Information we collect

We use your name, email, authentication provider identifier, account creation date and essential session information to operate your account. Learning features store progress, quizzes, bookmarks, notes, review schedules and achievements. Purchases record amount, status, timestamps, payment references, checkout email and access dates. Razorpay handles payment credentials; AlgoVerse does not store your full card number, CVV or UPI PIN.
Purpose and sharing

We process this information to authenticate you, save learning work, deliver purchased access, prevent abuse, reconcile payments and provide support. Google handles Google sign-in, Resend sends login links and receipts, and Razorpay processes payments. Our hosting and database infrastructure process service data. These providers may process data in other countries under their own terms. We do not sell personal data. Authorized administrators can view account and purchase information for support.
Cookies and device storage

Essential cookies maintain authentication. Browser storage keeps theme preferences, guest learning work and account-scoped learning state. Signing out clears account learning state in that browser. Guest work may merge after verified sign-in. See our cookie policy for controls.
Retention and deletion

Account and learning information remains while your account exists. You can export or delete it from your account page. Deletion removes linked learning data, sessions and provider credentials and clears checkout email. Payment reconciliation records remain without an account link; legally required accounting records and provider-held records may be retained. Backup copies may remain until backup rotation. Expiry of paid access does not itself delete your learning history.
Your rights and security

Contact support to request access, correction or deletion or to raise a privacy concern. We verify account ownership before acting. Use the account export and deletion controls where available. We use access controls and authentication, but no system guarantees absolute security. Never send passwords, OTPs, payment PINs or secret keys to support.
Children and changes

If you are below the applicable age of digital consent, use the service with a parent or guardian. Contact us about information collected from a child without required permission. Material policy changes will be published here; applicable privacy rights remain unaffected.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.description: Account rules, five-year access terms, payment conditions and educational-use terms for AlgoVerse.
sections: Using AlgoVerse

By using the service you agree to these terms. Keep account information accurate and sign-in links private. Your account and purchased access are personal and may not be resold or shared commercially. Do not bypass access controls, misuse the service or redistribute protected lesson content.
Five-year All Access

All Access is a one-time purchase covering five calendar years from verified payment capture. It includes current and future lessons made available during that term, subject to service availability. The price and any discount are shown before checkout. Access ends at the displayed expiry time; you may then purchase a new five-year term at the price offered at that time. There is no automatic renewal or recurring charge. Free lessons remain available. Existing grants are dated from their original grant date; the account page shows the applicable expiry.
Payments, delivery and refunds

Razorpay processes payments. The server confirms capture before enabling access. Delivery is digital; there is no physical shipment. Do not pay again while a payment is uncertain; check your account or contact support. Our refund and digital delivery policies form part of these terms.
Educational scope and intellectual property

Lessons are educational models and references, with the assumptions stated in each lesson. They do not guarantee employment, provider certification or production suitability. Respect intellectual property and any licenses accompanying code. Use security examples only on systems where you have authorization.
Availability and account restrictions

We may correct or improve content and temporarily interrupt service for maintenance or security. We may restrict accounts for fraud or abuse and investigate with appropriate notice where possible. These terms do not exclude mandatory consumer rights or remedies for failure to deliver purchased access.
Changes and disputes

Material changes will be published here. Contact support first about disputes or access problems. Applicable consumer and privacy protections continue to apply. No future renewal is charged without a new purchase.

refunds.title: Refund & cancellation policy
refunds.description: How to request a refund for digital access and what happens after an approved refund.
sections: Requesting a refund

Contact support within seven days of purchase for duplicate charges, accidental purchases or unresolved access failures. Include your registered email, payment reference, purchase date and a short explanation. Do not send card numbers, passwords, OTPs or payment PINs. Mandatory statutory refund rights are unaffected by this request window.
Review and processing

Support reviews the payment and access issue before approving a refund. Approved refunds are submitted to Razorpay for return to the original payment method; bank and provider processing times vary. A support request or pending refund is not proof that funds have reached your bank. Contact support with the reference if a refund is delayed.
Access after refund and cancellation

A completed refund revokes access linked to that payment. Completion certificates may be revoked when no other valid grant remains. This is a one-time five-year purchase: there is no recurring subscription to cancel. You can choose not to renew after expiry. Account deletion is separate from a refund request and does not automatically refund a payment.

shipping.title: Digital delivery policy
shipping.description: How AlgoVerse delivers online access after payment confirmation.
sections: Delivery

All products are online educational access. There are no physical shipments or shipping fees. All Access is enabled after server verification of a captured payment. The five-year term and expiry appear in your account.
Delayed access

Sign in with the same account used at checkout. If access is delayed, check payment status in your account and contact support with the payment reference. Avoid creating another charge while the first outcome is uncertain. An unsuccessful or uncaptured payment does not grant access.

contact.title: Contact & support
contact.description: Contact AlgoVerse about account access, payments, privacy and learning content.
sections: How to ask for help

For account or privacy requests, use your registered email. For payment questions, include the purchase date and Razorpay reference. For a lesson issue, include its URL and the steps that reproduce the problem. Never share passwords, OTPs, sign-in links or API keys.
Payment and privacy concerns

Use the support contact below for access failures, refund requests, corrections, data rights and grievances. We verify ownership before making account changes. The account page also offers data export and account deletion.

about.title: About AlgoVerse
about.description: Visual, interactive learning across algorithms, system design, databases and cloud.
sections: See it. Try it. Understand it.
AlgoVerse teaches computer science through step-by-step visuals, editable examples, reference code and quizzes. Start with a free lesson and follow a guided path at your own pace.
Curriculum

Explore data structures and algorithms, system design, databases and cloud concepts. Lessons state their teaching assumptions and scope. Educational examples do not operate real infrastructure or guarantee professional certification.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.description: Essential authentication cookies, local learning storage and your browser controls.
sections: Essential cookies

Authentication uses cookies to keep you signed in and protect login requests. Blocking these cookies can prevent account and purchase features from working. Cookies are not used as proof of a paid entitlement; the server checks access.
Local storage

Theme preferences, guest progress and account-scoped learning work may be kept on your device. Signing out clears browser account learning state. You can remove local storage and cookies through browser settings; unsynced guest work may be lost.
Third-party services

Google sign-in and Razorpay checkout may set cookies or process device information under their own policies. Email links are sent by Resend. Review provider policies when using those services. This policy does not claim that browser storage can disable providers required to complete a requested login or payment.
